newsitem.title: USA: Boston Scientific stumped by shr activity.
newsitem.headline: Boston Scientific stumped by shr activity.

text.p: Boston Scientific Corp said on Wednesday that it is unaware of any reason for today's trading activity in its stock, which fell 3-7/8 to 50-3/8 in late afternoon trading.
The company said, in a prepared statement, that it is aware of news reports that attribute today's market activity to comments made at an analysts' meeting held today.
But the company said it does not believe any new material information was disclosed at the meeting.
The company said it issued the statement in response to a request from the New York Stock Exchange for comment on today's trading activity.
